description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water)], [Awoken Black Magic], [Damage Cap +10000] and [High Speed Onion] to the user

description.name: Awoken Black Magic
description.text: Black Magic abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Fire/Earth/Wind/Water ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: High Speed Onion
description.text: Grants [Black Magic +30% Boost 3] and [Attach Fire]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water] after using three Fire/Earth/Wind/Water abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Earth/Wind/Water damage, removed after triggering

description.name: Black Magic +30% Boost 3
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%
